button.label: Send via MPC
button.supertip: Secret-shares the text and every attachment into additive shares (mod 2^61 - 1), one per MPC server published by the recipient's domain (_mpc1._tcp, _mpc2._tcp SRV records), and sends each share with the X-MPC-* headers. Each MPC server relays only its own share, which reveals nothing on its own. The text is sent as plain text.
